html:
INSID3 (2026): finds the object shown in one or more example images with masks in a new image, without training, from Meta's DINOv3 features. Apache-2.0 code; the DINOv3 weights are under the gated DINOv3 licence.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: INSID3: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with DINOv3, CVPR 2026, 2026-03-30
  • Original code: https://github.com/visinf/INSID3 at 0c165a10cf52
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: LicenseRef-DINOv3-License
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/visinf/INSID3/blob/0c165a10cf52ab91f335883d06260de86854adbe/LICENSE (Apache-2.0); backbone weights: https://huggingface.co/facebook/dinov3-vitl16-pretrain-lvd1689m (DINOv3 License, gated)
  • Training data: training-free; the DINOv3 backbone: LVD-1689M (1.689B curated Instagram images, self-supervised), not released
  • Licence note: The INSID3 code is Apache-2.0; it ships no weights of its own and runs the DINOv3 ViT-L/16 checkpoint, which is under the DINOv3 License (Meta: attribution and conditions apply; gated on Hugging Face); read it before commercial use.
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, dpt_fused
  • Variants: insid3-vitl16
  • Outputs: similarity, masks
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized inside to the fixed encoder input 1024x1024 (the default export size)
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): insid3-vitl16 1080x1920 (1.0 GiB peak allocated, 1.3 reserved)
  • insid3-vitl16 original (fp32) 1024x1024: visinf/INSID3@0c165a10cf52 set_reference + set_target + segment, its encoder autocast off
  • insid3-vitl16 original 1024x1024: the authors' mixed-precision option (bfloat16); visinf/INSID3@0c165a10cf52 set_reference + set_target + segment, bf16 autocast (as shipped)
  • insid3-vitl16 load / first call: original 1.06 s / 1.114 s, portable 1.85 s / 0.344 s, kernels 3.03 s / 0.294 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

In-context: per COCO class 3 (reference, target) pairs drawn with seed 0 from the images whose class covers >= 2 %, the class's non-crowd instances as one mask; foreground IoU summed per class, mean over the 80 classes. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
